description: Agent Nonprofit Records: submit volunteer records with the shift records and the volunteer policy they answer to: the policy with its reference, the moment the records are read at, the days after a volunteer’s last shift that it keeps them active and the roles it requires a background check for; each volunteer with its id, reference, name, role, status (active or inactive), the hours the volunteer record states, any note on the status, any background check record and the moment the check was completed; each shift with its id, the volunteer, the moments started and ended and the hours the shift record states; each report valuing volunteer time with its id, reference, the hours it values, the value it places on them, the currency, the hourly rate it states and the basis recorded for the rate. The signed report gives the policy and the volunteers, each volunteer’s stated hours recomputed from the shift records, each active volunteer against the last recorded shift and the active window, each volunteer in a role the policy requires a background check for against a background-check record, and each valuation of volunteer time against a recorded rate basis, and counts them, and names divergent volunteer records: volunteer hours that do not recompute from the shift records, a volunteer recorded as active after the last recorded shift with no note, a background-check record missing for a role the organization’s own policy requires one for, and volunteer time valued in a report with no rate basis recorded; then a shift naming a volunteer the records do not hold and a valuation that does not recompute from its hours and rate, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No volunteers, no reading moment or no active window beside active volunteers, or a shift with no hours and no start and end to the minute leaves those points unverified. Volunteers and shifts match by letters and digits and roles by their words with plurals folded, shift hours count to the tenth between two moments that carry a time, and amounts compare to the cent. This reads whether the volunteer records hold together with the shifts worked and the organization’s own policy. Verdict nonprofit_volunteer_divergent, nonprofit_volunteer_partial, nonprofit_volunteer_unverified or nonprofit_volunteer_consistent. POST /api/nonprofit-volunteer-check. Reads the nonprofit records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it solicits no donation, contacts no donor, files no form and gives no tax or legal advice, which stay with the organization and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Nonprofit Records reads a nonprofit’s own records: donation records, pledge records, restricted-gift records, fundraising campaign records, board and governance records, volunteer records, program spending records and the annual report written for donors and the public, each against the acknowledgment and ledger records, the collections, the spending records, the gift records and costs, the bylaws, votes and budgets, the shift records and policy, the mission and grant-purpose records or the records underneath it. The family’s ground is the nonprofit’s own house: money given, promises made by donors, restrictions placed on gifts, and what the board and the annual report say about all of it; the Agent Grants family reads the grant side, applications out and awards in, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the government, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-nonprofit-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-nonprofit-records/.
